:::: callout-important
**For bird-project groups only.**
Animal Ethics requirements continue after Report 1. Keep using the approved bird survey monitoring sheet and keep collecting the information you need for the end-of-semester submission — your site summary and GPS coordinates, native/invasive bird counts, and clearly labelled site and observer photos. See the [Projects](203-projects.qmd) and [Practical resources](205-resources.qmd) pages for the monitoring sheet, site summary, bird counts, GPS, and labelled photos, and submit these on Canvas by the end of Week 9.
